answer.worked:
The diagram contains two $x$ tiles and two positive unit tiles.
$$\begin{align*}2(x+1)&=2(x)+2(1)\\&=2x+2\end{align*}$$

The diagram contains two $x$ tiles and four negative unit tiles.
$$\begin{align*}2(x-2)&=2(x)+2(-2)\\&=2x-4\end{align*}$$

The diagram contains two $x$ tiles and eight positive unit tiles.
$$\begin{align*}2(x+4)&=2(x)+2(4)\\&=2x+8\end{align*}$$

The diagram contains three $x$ tiles and three positive unit tiles.
$$\begin{align*}3(x+1)&=3(x)+3(1)\\&=3x+3\end{align*}$$

The diagram contains three $x$ tiles and six negative unit tiles.
$$\begin{align*}3(x-2)&=3(x)+3(-2)\\&=3x-6\end{align*}$$
